items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I know May's a good musician, good piano player.

ctx.x: Oh, I was going to ask you about this woman May that played piano. Who May? Did you ever think of her name or where she lives or who would know her?
I don't know where it may be, but I know May's a good musician, good piano player. Who knows them? Who a lot of musicians know all of them?
I mean well enough so they keep in touch with him. But I don't know.
